description: This file defines an abstract PHP class named 'FormBase' which provides common functionality for form handling in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods to determine if a save operation was triggered from the DCMenu and to check if return module and action parameters are empty, aiding in workflow management within forms.

classes.name: FormBase
classes.description: An abstract class that provides shared form-related functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: isSaveFromDCMenu
methods.description: Checks whether the save action was triggered from the DCMenu by inspecting POST data.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnModuleAndAction
methods.description: Determines if the return_module and return_action POST parameters are empty, indicating a non-navigational save.
